hero.title: Review PO submissions with the dedicated PR Auditor worker.
hero.subtitle: Upload Final PO and EPMS once. The worker creates ECC entitlement, audits PO claims, and preserves evidence in one controlled run.

actions.missingFilesMessage: Upload Final PO and EPMS workbooks to start.
actions.validationMessage: Validate Final PO and EPMS workbooks before running the audit.

final_po.title: Final PO Upload
final_po.label: Final PO workbook
final_po.hint: Upload the current Final PO workbook to be audited.

epms.title: EPMS Upload
epms.label: EPMS workbook
epms.hint: Upload EPMS site data. create-pr-cd will generate the TSS and TI entitlement used by the audit.

uploadGroups.title: Final PO Period
uploadGroups.subtitle: Dispatch Date filter
uploadGroups.hint: Only Final PO rows with a Dispatch Date in this period will be audited.

stages.title: Create entitlement
stages.description: create-pr-cd reads EPMS and generates mandatory TSS and TI ECC lines.

stages.title: Audit Final PO
stages.description: tx-pr-auditor compares Final PO only with the generated ECC entitlement.

stages.title: Deliver evidence
stages.description: Download the audit workbook or complete delivery archive. Uploaded source files remain unchanged.

configuration.notice: One job runs both engines in order. EPMS is never passed into the focused tx-pr-auditor audit engine. Audit findings require business review.

compatibility.promotionPolicy: Auditor release tests must prove parity with an explicitly pinned create-pr-cd registry snapshot.
